title: Restriction-corestriction is multiplication by subgroup index
statement: Using [def-exc-continuous-cohomology], let $G$ be a profinite group, let $H\subseteq G$ be an open subgroup, let $M$ be a finite discrete continuous $G$-module, and let $q\ge0$. In continuous cohomology, the restriction map $H^q(G,M)\to H^q(H,M)$ followed by corestriction back to $H^q(G,M)$ is multiplication by the finite index $[G:H]$.
